Which accent colour should highlight key items like callouts and links?

❯ 1. Teal (Recommended)
     Calm and high-contrast on both light and dark backgrounds.
  2. Amber
     Warm and attention-grabbing. Good for warnings, but can feel loud for links.
  3. Indigo
     Formal and neutral. Pairs well with a light neutral palette.
